## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in the atlas.

## Case-review checklist

- [ ] The source is public, real, and linked at an immutable revision.
- [ ] The prediction task and evaluation boundary are documented.
- [ ] Exact code/data evidence is cited.
- [ ] The information path is traced; the verdict is not based only on a code pattern.
- [ ] Confidence and impact labels match the available evidence.
- [ ] Reproduction status is accurate and failures are recorded.
- [ ] Wording is neutral and does not speculate about intent.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_cases.py` and the tests pass.
